title: Вызов лучшего друга  (Calling the Best Friend)

segments.t: After Senya switches sides on the stand and blames Max completely, Max sarcastically congratulates Kostya on his bribery skills, prompting Kostya to call himself as Max's loyal best friend.
Значит, на самом деле было вот так.
Он сам полез целоваться к этой Саше!
На этом у меня всё, Ваша честь.
Да, Костя, классно ты его подкупил!
Не переживай, Макс, всё будет в порядке.
У меня есть ещё один надёжный свидетель.
Этот человек точно на твоей стороне.
Ваша честь, я вызываю лучшего друга Максима.
В зал приглашается свидетель Константин Анисимов!
Скажите, Константин, что вы думаете о подсудимом?
Костя, только ничего лишнего там не сболтни!
Доверься мне, я же твой лучший друг.

'So, in reality it happened like this.' Between the call and the friend, Senya gives Kostya a quick, grounded response.

'He tried to kiss that Sasha himself!' Declaring that he tried to kiss that Sasha himself brings Senya's temper right to the surface.

'That is all I have to say, Your Honor.' Even though that is all he has to say Kostya's honor, Senya keeps a steady face in front of Kostya. Russian expresses having something as "by me is", keeping the phrase short and grounded.

'Yeah, Kostya, you bribed him so well!' With the point and friend at stake, Max reacts without holding back. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.

'This person is definitely on your side.' Adding that this person is definitely on Max's side fills in the missing piece for Max.

'Your Honor, I call Maxim's best friend.' Saying that Max's honor he calls Maxim best friend is how Kostya sets the tone with Max.

'Witness Konstantin Anisimov is called to the hall!' Declaring that witness Konstantin Anisimov is called to the hall brings Kostya's temper right to the surface. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Скажите, Константин, что вы думаете о подсудимом?

'Tell us, Konstantin, what do you think of the defendant?' Kostya asks whether tell them Konstantin what do Max thinks of the defendant, refusing to let the point slide. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
